# The Legion Y700 2023's gralloc aborts allocating a hardware buffer for the 860 MB memory pool: there, add DM_VK_ZEROCOPY_MAX_MB=512 to env.txt (the pool is
# copied instead). Not a default any more: on the Retroid Pocket 6 the copied pool cost 1.5 GB of memory (PSS) and swap, and its submits took twice as long
# Retroid Pocket 6 (Adreno 740, Turnip T30 through --vulkan-driver, graphics pipeline libraries), 2026-11-15: shader preparation 6.7 s (2,835 parts), 60 fps held
# (4,800 frames, p50 16.7 ms, GPU 6.9 ms), 152 linked pipelines taken over by their whole ones in p50 4.5 ms, no colour flashes seen, so dynamic uniform buffers
# stay on (DM_VK_DYN_UBO=0 would make a descriptor set per draw in a ~3,000-draw battle; see Dark Souls' profile for the flashes it fixes there)
# The rate is held at 60: the adaptive rate sat at 40 in battle on the Retroid Pocket 6 (with its performance mode at "performance" or above it holds 60)
env
# The pause menu's Frame rate limit (settings.txt limit=) is left at Auto, the pin above: a held 40 fps (120 Hz on the Retroid Pocket 6, whose display runs 60
# or 120 Hz) shows the heaviest maps (~6,800 draws, GPU-bound at ~17 ms a frame) evenly where 60 wavers between 46 and 60 fps, but the player chose 60 as the
# default (2026-11-15: the display at 120 Hz for 40 fps judged a waste); 40 or 30 stay one press away in the menu
# handheld (720p) by default: docked 1080p took 34 ms of GPU a frame in battle on that device (about 22 fps), handheld 11-20 ms
setting
# the replay on its own thread: in battle it took 17.5 ms of the game thread's 33 ms a frame (about 3,000 draws), which held the adaptive rate at 30 fps
env
# colour render targets keep Adreno's UBWC compression: the opening's GPU time 35-40% lower (14 to 8-9 ms at about 550 draws)
env
# back up to 60 fps judged on the median frame: at 40 its p90 stayed at 21-25 ms though it held 60 with 1-2 of 64 frames late
env
# the battle map draws ~2,030 of its ~3,500 draws in one pass without depth (13 ms of GPU): split every 512 draws, the GPU starts on it while the replay records the rest.
# Retroid Pocket 6 (Turnip T30), 2026-11-15: the rainy town map's battle preview (~5,300 draws) held 48 fps: the game waits on its frame's fence before it submits
# the next (the present thread's SyncWait, DM_NVN_SEQ), so a frame was replay 13.6 + GPU tail 5.9 ms, and its 1920x1080 pass with depth was never split. Every 256
# draws, passes with depth too (begin_pass's LRZ write-back): GPU tail 5.9 to 2.6-3.0 ms, 16.5 ms frames, 60 fps, nothing broken on screen (same scene, A/B live)
env
env
# the replay thread on the prime core: the battle map's replay 12.5 to 10.0 ms a frame (all big cores: no change)
env
# under one layout only the sets that changed are bound again: the battle map's replay 9.6 to 8.5-8.9 ms a frame
